May 1                            Budget to City Council

May 4-14                         Department Work Sessions with City Council to present budget requests

May 10                           City Council Meeting 1st Reading – 6:00 p.m. (will be referred to May 19th Committee
                                 of the Whole)

May 19                           Committee of the Whole – 6:00 p.m.

May 24                           City Council Meeting 2nd Reading – 6:00 p.m. (returns to the Committee of the Whole
                                 on June 9th)

May 29                           Notice of hearing published in newspaper with budget summary

June 9                           Committee of the Whole – 6:00 p.m.

June 14                          City Council Meeting – Public Hearing and 3rd Reading – 6:00 p.m. (Hearing must be
                                 held no later than 3rd Tuesday in June per W.S. 16-4-109. Budget must be approved
